title: An Act to Address Concerns Regarding Radiation Machines and Similar Equipment Used in the Cannabis Industry

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to amend the laws governing cannabis to address concerns about the health effects of the use of radiation machines and similar equipment used to treat, decontaminate or remediate cannabis flower and trim and to protect consumers from the unknowing or unwanted use of products that have been processed using these machines or equipment.

This bill also proposes to clarify the laws governing testing requirements for adult use cannabis and cannabis products.
